name: Kindlet · Gremlet #2
description:
A melting-candle sprite whose flame flares when it's happy and dims to an ember when it naps.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Kindlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
